title: rumex acetosa subsp. hibernicus
intro: Rumex acetosa subsp. hibernicus, commonly known as wild sorrel or Irish sorrel, is a subspecies of the common sorrel plant (Rumex acetosa) found in Europe and Ireland. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its high content of vitamin C and antioxidants. The therapeutic actions of Rumex acetosa subsp. hibernicus include its anti-inflammatory and diuretic properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections and other conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include ascorbic acid, flavonoids, and anthraquinones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
